description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseRealtimeConfig' for configuring real-time interactions with a language model API. It includes abstract methods for validating the environment, transforming requests, and processing responses, as well as some utility methods and type annotations related to real-time response transformation.

classes.name: BaseRealtimeConfig
classes.description: An abstract base class outlining methods for real-time API configuration, request transformation, and response processing in language model integrations.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Abstract method to validate the API environment, requiring headers, model, and optional API key.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Generates the complete URL for API requests, default implementation returns 'api_base' or empty string.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Creates and returns an exception instance for error handling based on message, status code, and headers.

methods.name: List[str] transform_realtime_request( self, message: str, model: str, session_configuration_request: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Abstract method to transform the input message into a real-time request format.

methods.name: bool requires_session_configuration( self, )
methods.description: Indicates if a session configuration message is required; defaults to False.

methods.name: Optional[str] session_configuration_request( self, model: str )
methods.description: Provides a session setup message if needed; default returns None.

methods.name: RealtimeResponseTypedDict transform_realtime_response( self, message: Union[str, bytes], model: str, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, realtime_response_transform_input: RealtimeResponseTransformInput, )
methods.description: Abstract method to process the real-time response message, returning a structured dict.
